'''Brannin Martan''' is an [[Andoran]] noble of a minor House. He is married to [[Elvaine Martan]].

== Appearance ==
He is gray haired.

== Activities ==
He is one of the nobles to have thrown their support behind [[Elayne Trakand]] and brought their extended family as armsmen to [[Caemlyn]].

When Elayne is captured by the [[Black Ajah]], Brannin, Elvaine and their armsmen aid [[Birgitte Silverbow]] in rescuing her.
